description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment.As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting patients in regaining independence in daily living activities. Your responsibilities will include implementing individualized treatment plans, monitoring patient progress, and providing therapeutic interventions to enhance functional abilities.We are seeking a compassionate and skilled professional eager to make a significant impact. Compensation for this full-time role is competitive and based on experience.
requirements: Current Florida state licensure as a COTA
Previous experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
